subject.title: improve(ui): declutter the Cron Jobs page into compact scannable rows

question: Should the compact-row Cron Jobs layout in this PR be accepted as the desired Control UI direction after a current-main refresh?
rationale: The patch is a user-facing layout redesign for a protected maintainer-labeled issue, so correctness checks do not decide whether this is the product shape maintainers want.

options.title: Accept After Refresh
options.body: Refresh the branch onto current main, rerun the relevant UI checks, and land the compact row layout if the refreshed merge result stays UI-only.

options.title: Request Layout Revisions
options.body: Keep this PR open but ask for specific row, menu, detail, or responsive-layout changes before merge.

options.title: Decline This Direction
options.body: Close this PR and the linked issue only if maintainers decide the current Cron Jobs density should remain or be redesigned separately.

recommendation.title: Accept After Refresh
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch onto current main, rerun the relevant UI checks, and land the compact row layout if the refreshed merge result stays UI-only.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the linked issue/PR pair and is the clearest product-direction contact for this proposed layout.
